senses.gloss: m. (prob. a. geogr. term) ibrosi, name of a species of olive of medium size, also called אֵגוֹרִי q. v.
units: Ber. 39ᵃ its name is not egori, אלא א׳ וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. אברוטי, Ar. ed. Koh. אברוצי) but its original name is ibrosi or as some say סִבְרוֹסִי Ms. M. (ed. סמרוסי); Y. Bicc. I, 63ᵈ bot. (אוורוס) אווריס.
